```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
  induction n with d hd
  case zero =>
    exact le_refl (0 + 1)
  case succ =>
    have h1 : 2 * 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, mul_comm, pow_one]
    calc
      (d + 1) + 1 ≤ 2 * (d + 1) : add_le_add_right (le_reflect (d + 1) 2) _
      ... ≤ 2 * 2 ^ d : mul_le_mul_left (hd d) 2
      ... = 2 ^ (d + 1) : h1
```
